title: Phone layout: one pane at a time, a bottom tab bar, larger touch targets
spec: Below PHONE_MAX_WIDTH (600 points) the chat screen shows one pane at a time (REQUIREMENTS 2.9): Chats (full-width room buttons with unread counts), Conversation (a '< Chats' back button, the feed, the composer; the tab bar gives way), and Account (who is signed in, the server, Sign out). A bottom tab bar switches between Chats and Account; touch targets are at least TOUCH_TARGET (44 points) high. Opening a room from Chats emits Command::Sync as on the desktop. Sign-out returns to Chats. Desktop widths keep the side-by-side layout.
